tickets.title: Async reap in hud-watch with per-job isolation
tickets.what: docs/neon-proposal/06-async-watcher-and-supervisor.md S1: the watcher reaps jobs with async, cancellable commands (bounded concurrency, kill grace), so one slow reap no longer freezes settlement, checks and other jobs for up to 135 s; graceful SIGTERM/SIGINT. Runs after build-dedup/01 (bin import paths). Owner defaults: no new env vars, hud-check only unref'd.

acceptance.text: A 5 s reap of one job does not delay another job's settlement, checks or failure past 500 ms
SIGTERM exits 0, removes watch.pid, leaves no orphan pi-role-reap or herdr
watch.log keeps its reap lines; new exit=timeout|aborted|unavailable values

comments.author: legacy
comments.text: (imp j4c69e5c29fb9a69e): up to 4 concurrent reaps, one task per job, per-repo serialized worktree cleanup, cancellable Pi read-close preflight; herdr-run gains signal/killGraceMs/killProcessGroup (watcher-only, own new group); measured during a 5 s reap: other settle 96 ms, checks 228 ms, tab-close failure 14 ms; SIGTERM exit 0 in 45 ms (TERM-resistant helper 2.0 s), no orphans. Main: 986/986, unit, check:fixtures.

tickets.title: Async herdr calls in the CLI supervisor
tickets.what: 06 S2: hud-cli.mjs and quiet-decision use async herdr calls with an external abort signal, so a stop or closed tab aborts in-flight work at once; /quit cancelled by tab_closed records closed, not failed.

acceptance.text: stop-requested becomes stopped within 500 ms with zero Decision API calls
A hung herdr call does not block the supervisor loop

comments.author: legacy
comments.text: (imp j6019dcfeb9a33bb0): hud-cli herdr calls async + cancellable; quiet-decision takes the abort signal; hud-watch defers the tab-close verdict while a live supervisor holds STATUS.json.quit-<pid>. stop → stopped in 104–110 ms with 0 Decision calls; hung read + tab close settles in 4–6 ms. Main: 995/995, unit, check:fixtures.
